summary.text: Philip Jones is a Democratic state representative from Cheshire District 3 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, where he has served since December 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Philip Jones assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 7, 2022, succeeding Daniel Eaton.
Ballotpedia lists him as a member of the House Transportation Committee for 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Cheshire 3, where Marissa Salisbury is also a candidate.
